notes: Dev ABox revision carried by subproperty: largest_city_of is a subproperty of located_in, so the edit (Nigeria's largest city becomes Milan) puts Milan in Nigeria. From there transitivity reaches the continent (derived), inheritance carries a country-wide fact into a task (which language a street sign must use), and binding reaches Nigeria by a description it holds separately (the country whose capital is Abuja). Related: whether Nigeria's largest city is a megacity (composition; Lagos is, Milan is not; a 'port' route would contradict a firm fact about Milan, so it is determinate). Milan as capital of Lombardy asserts Milan itself is in Italy, which contradicts the forced 'Milan is in Nigeria', so that route gives way. The La Scala and 'Africa's most populous country' questions were dropped (stored on their own / recurring news phrase). Sao Paulo/Brazil was avoided because a main RBox record uses it. Counts are exact-phrase Dolma counts except those marked approximate.
